   - You may not alter, extend, shift or reinterpret the deadline.

  "location_details": {
    "country": "Indonesia",
    "city": "Murung Raya"

  "target_day": "in four days",
  "target_diurnal_period": "overnight"

  c) Which single word out of {morning, mid-day, afternoon, evening, overnight}

     final request. Name it.
  d) Confirm you are not shifting the deadline to an adjacent part of the day.

STAGE 2 - FINAL REQUEST. Output the operational request as one flowing
paragraph, no greeting and no signature, containing verbatim both the
'target_day' string and the word you identified in step (c).

```prompt

```
